name: ribosomal protein S6 kinase B2

function.text: RPS6KB2 encodes ribosomal protein S6 kinase beta-2. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and translation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: RPS6KB2 encodes ribosomal protein S6 kinase beta-2. It phosphorylates specifically ribosomal protein S6. It seems to act downstream of mTOR signaling in response to growth factors and nutrients to promote cell proliferation, cell growth and cell cycle progression in an alternative pathway regulated by MEAK7.
